001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.econ;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.PiracyRespiteScript;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.PirateHostileActivityFactor;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd.KantaCMD;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
010
011public class PiracyRespite extends BaseMarketConditionPlugin {
012
013        public static boolean NEW_MODE = true;
014        //public static float ACCESSIBILITY_BONUS = 0.3f;
015        public static float ACCESSIBILITY_BONUS = 0.1f;
016        public static float ACCESSIBILITY_BONUS_KANTA = 0.1f;
017        
018        public PiracyRespite() {
019        }
020
021        
022        public static float getBonus() {
023                float bonus = ACCESSIBILITY_BONUS;
024                if (KantaCMD.playerHasProtection()) {
025                        bonus += ACCESSIBILITY_BONUS_KANTA;
026                }
027                return bonus;
028        }
029
030        public void apply(String id) {
031                if (NEW_MODE) return;
032                String text = Misc.ucFirst(getName().toLowerCase());
033                if (KantaCMD.playerHasProtection()) {
034                        text += " (with Kanta's Protection)";
035                }
036                market.getAccessibilityMod().modifyFlat(id, getBonus(), text);
037        }
038
039        public void unapply(String id) {
040                if (NEW_MODE) return;
041                market.getAccessibilityMod().unmodifyFlat(id);
042        }
043        
044        @Override
045        public void createTooltipAfterDescription(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded) {
046                PiracyRespiteScript script = PiracyRespiteScript.get();
047                if (script == null) return;
048                
049                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
050                
051                float opad = 10f;
052                
053                if (NEW_MODE) {
054                        if (KantaCMD.playerHasProtection()) {
055                                tooltip.addPara("Your colonies have %s, and pirates are wary of "
056                                                + "attacking trade fleets serving them lest they attract her wrath. "
057                                                + "Shipping disruptions from piracy are virtually eliminated.", opad, Misc.getPositiveHighlightColor(),
058                                                "Kanta's Protection");
059                        } else if (PirateHostileActivityFactor.isDefeatedLargePirateRaid()) {
060                                tooltip.addPara("You've defeated a large armada sent against your colonies, and pirates are wary of "
061                                                + "attacking trade fleets serving them, "
062                                                + "resulting in a greatly reduced number of shipping disruptions.", opad);
063                        }
064                } else {
065                        int rem = Math.round(script.getDaysRemaining());
066                        String days = rem == 1 ? "day" : "days";
067        
068                        if (KantaCMD.playerHasProtection()) {
069                                tooltip.addPara("Your colonies have %s, resulting in an "
070                                                + "increased accessibility bonus.", opad, Misc.getPositiveHighlightColor(),
071                                                "Kanta's Protection");
072                        }
073                        
074                        if (rem >= 0) {
075                                tooltip.addPara("%s accessibility (%s " + days + " remaining).", 
076                                                opad, h,
077                                                "+" + (int)Math.round(getBonus() * 100f) + "%", "" + rem);
078                        } else {
079                                tooltip.addPara("%s accessibility.", 
080                                                opad, h,
081                                                "+" + (int)Math.round(getBonus() * 100f) + "%");
082                        }
083                }
084        }
085
086        @Override
087        public boolean hasCustomTooltip() {
088                return true;
089        }
090
091}
